title: Drill Arena
description:
Fight in a brutal battle between robots with drills. In the arena there are only you and your opponents. Only the most sturdy and agile robot will survive!Features• Online steam multiplayer for 2-6 players

• 3 types of robots to play with different advantages and disadvantages

• Custom color of your robot

• Opponents are equal to you in terms of capabilities and will use all methods available to you for survival
